I replied in #central-team to Pree. I couldn't find the site for the store with the afternoon-only shift screen.

The only record is your June 9 message in #central-team about "Pine Crossing." That thread doesn't give a location. The SUP-5102 onboarding ticket lists six new Marrow Agrisupply stores (North Creek, Elm Junction, Prairie Bend, Mill Crossing, West Ridge, South Fork), and Pine Crossing isn't among them. The store address sheet that ticket refers to isn't in what I can access, so I didn't guess a site.
